thread:
Alex K: Quick sync — planning the support/escalation lane for on-prem marketplace + SI sidecar deployments (Retail partner). Goal: clear 1) who to ping, 2) war room setup, 3) telemetry handoff. Proposed: shared channel #partner-retail-onprem, a dedicated oncall rotation (partner L1), and Redwood SEV triage rules. Thoughts?

Maya R: +1 on shared channel. Suggest naming convention #partner-retail-onprem-sev for auto-bridges. Also: require partner SRE contact + SI lead in first 10m.

Jamal: For war rooms we should use ephemeral relay: start with shared Slack channel + create bridge only if SEV2+ — reduces noise. Also require pre-authorized bridge ops: @oncall to create. Will add runbook snippet.

Oncall Bot: Incident created: SEV-RETAIL-001. Bridge: not created (criteria: SEV2+). Pager duty alerted: Retail-Onprem-L1.

Sara (PS): From SI side: partner wants pinned escalation matrix in channel + weekly drill. Can we add a short pinned doc w/ contact tree and required logs collection steps? They need offline handoff for air-gapped installs.

Cloud Partner Liaison: We'll supply partner SRE rotation + support email. Also recommend we provide a "collector sidecar" troubleshooting script partners can run to dump logs to S3 (or secure mailbox) — keeps PII out. I'll coordinate.

Alex K: Draft runbook below — please sign off. We'll pin in the channel.

```
1) Triage: On alert, partner posts initial message with short summary + environment tag (e.g., prod-retail-onprem).
2) 0-10m: Redwood L1 + Partner SRE join channel, confirm severity.
3) 10-30m: If SEV2 or >, start war room bridge, assign owner (Redwood SE)
4) Action items: collect collector output, last 1000 tokens of inference logs, model id/version, config snapshot.
5) Postmortem owner: whoever first assigns a fix ticket.
```

Maya R: minor tweak: change "last 1000 tokens" -> "last 10k lines or last 1k tokens" maybe ambiguous — suggest "inference trace last 1k tokens + request IDs".

Jamal: Also add automatic routing rule: if request latency > X and error rate > Y -> escalate to SEV2. I'll open a PR to infra routing.

Alex K: cool. Who will create channel and pinned doc? Cloud Partner Liaison?

Cloud Partner Liaison: I'll create channel and pin runbook today. Scheduling drill w/ partner for next Tue morning. I'll post the invite.

Sara (PS): :thumbsup: I'll prepare the SI checklist and sample collector script. Sharing shortly.

Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly drill reminder set for Tue 09:00 UTC.

Alex K: thanks — feel free to ping me if you need sign-off on access perms. :eyes:
